উপরি-উক্ত প্রজ্ঞাপনের-

Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of this Act empowers the Government, in consultation with the National Board of Revenue, to issue or amend notifications in the public interest.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: Section 14(1) of this Act provides the legal authority for the Government to enact amendments to tax-related notifications in the public interest.
National Board of Revenue: The Government is mandated to consult with this body when exercising its powers to amend customs and value added tax notifications.
S.R.O. 135-AIN/2015: This notification, originally issued in June 2015, is subject to further amendment under the current order.
